title: Convert Designer to the style-picker model (schema 2 manifest, dials, accents, Looks)
detail:
Plan step 9 for Designer: (1) manifest to schema 2 declaring today's four dials supported with THEME_LOOK defaults (owners see no change); (2) register, accent swatches, type voice, motion, hero/header/footer variants, image treatment, Looks, theme dials as the style system allows; (3) functions table mapping existing blocks to the twelve functions; conformance suite green before any dial flips to supported. NEEDS FROM DANIEL: Updated Designer style system, and whether a Night register is wanted.

Day is fixed. Four Looks use the existing Designer profiles and saved layout defaults stay unchanged.
